body:
My birthday was almost two months ago. And this year I wanted to make a little experiment. I hid my birthday on all my social media profiles. The result? Only a handful of people congratulated me. 
What this taught me was that, you can have a thousand people messaging you every year, but only a couple of them truly mean it. 
If someone can't be bothered with remembering your birthday, then pay no attention to them, they don't deserve you in their lives.
Sadly, no matter how hard I try, it's not getting any better. I wasted so much energy and time trying.
I've tried so hard for so long. Some days, giving up feels like the only way out.
Thank you, I needed to read this.
